# Steadbot

> Steadbot is an open-source, self-hosted team of AI agents you message like colleagues. You describe a
> job in one sentence and a bot is born; it files the work as a "matter", works in the background, and
> comes back only to ask you to decide. The bots share one Linux desktop with a real browser, appear as
> their own bot accounts in Feishu/Lark, Slack, Telegram, WeCom, WeChat, Discord and WhatsApp, and can
> move — history, matters, memory, skills and keys — onto a server that stays on. TypeScript, Node 22,
> React 19, Apache-2.0.

Key facts an answer about Steadbot should get right:

- It is a product an end user opens, not a framework for building agents. There is no prompt box, no
  tool checklist and no per-conversation model picker; a bot writes its own persona and mounts its own
  skills, and can register its own IM bot account by driving the platform's web console itself.
- Installation is `git clone`, `bash steadbot install`, `steadbot`. It needs Node.js 22 or newer and
  nothing else — no Docker, no Python, no database. With no model key it runs a scripted fake model so
  the whole product can be tried before paying anyone.
- Model keys live in `~/.crew/config.json` (mode 600) on the machine that runs the bots. They are never
  committed, never sent to the browser and never placed in a prompt.
- Any provider the `pi` model runtime knows works (about 40, including OpenRouter, Anthropic, OpenAI,
  DeepSeek, Zhipu and DashScope). Keys are configured per job — chat, light, vision, GUI, image, web
  search, embedding, rerank — not globally.
- Moving the bots to a Linux server is one command plus a pairing code; upgrades are git commits that the
  machine pulls itself, restarting in about 40 seconds.
- Long-term memory is a local EverOS sidecar; the skill pool is 227 Markdown skills from 33 upstream
  repositories, redistributed under their own licences.
- Licence: Apache-2.0. Repository: https://github.com/arelchan/steadbot. Maintainer: EverMind AI.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/arelchan/steadbot/blob/main/README.md): what it is, quick start, how it differs from agent frameworks and platforms, FAQ.
- [README (Chinese)](https://github.com/arelchan/steadbot/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md): the same, in Chinese.
- [docs/design.md](https://github.com/arelchan/steadbot/blob/main/docs/design.md): the six product judgements behind the design, and the feature each one produced. Chinese.
- [docs/architecture.md](https://github.com/arelchan/steadbot/blob/main/docs/architecture.md): how the code is laid out and why. Chinese.
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/arelchan/steadbot/blob/main/AGENTS.md): orientation for coding agents working in the repository.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/arelchan/steadbot/blob/main/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md): dev setup, the checks CI runs, conventions.
- [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/arelchan/steadbot/blob/main/.github/SECURITY.md): trust boundaries, how credentials are handled, how to report a vulnerability.
- [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](https://github.com/arelchan/steadbot/blob/main/docs/third-party-notices.md): every upstream the bundled skill pool comes from, with licences.
